title: Add Account isolated success

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Completing isolated Add Account must save the captured account as inactive while preserving the active This Mac account.
When a fake saved-account status client returns usable status after Add Account, CodexPill must apply returned email, plan, and rate-limit metadata to the new inactive account.
Successful isolated Add Account must clean up the isolated login session after capture and verification.

targetSurface: CodexPill Add Account fake-client workflow boundary

nonClaims: Does not prove native device-code panel rendering or browser sign-in.
Does not prove live Codex auth, live app-server, or real process relaunch.
Does not prove terminal failure cleanup paths.
Does not prove live macOS menu-bar behavior.
